scope_limits: Approves review readiness of a single root Spotless input-scope line, not merge approval, a stable release or an all-warning fix.
Local A/B actually ran formatter/check only. No local application build, JVM/native suite or device acceptance was performed or claimed in this task.
CI separately executed source formatting, app:testDebugUnitTest and Lint plus four OS debug builds; exact test case count and complete Lint XML are not exported. No previous 331 count is borrowed.

Only the three named cross-build producer warnings are proven removed by the local warning-mode=all A/B. CI retains 133 mechanical diagnostic matches in context; no application-source candidate is a scoped classifier result, not a zero-warning guarantee.
Unexpanded Gradle deprecation origins remain unknown. Local setVisible warning remains; optional static dependency investigation does not establish an upgrade was tested.

Original Ubuntu APK was produced from GitHub synthetic merge 12cb921103bf57c5a129758fa8b4f70bdb6c79c5 whose complete tree equals the head; it was neither changed nor resigned. Build-time Git metadata may differ from a direct head build.
No native freshness claim is inferred from CI success; actual per-job cache/build records remain in raw logs.
This review hashes only preexisting frozen inputs; it does not modify earlier A/B/committed/local/CI records or introduce hash cycles.
qualification_decision: The tested, committed one-line patch and source-bound 5/5 CI are sufficient for this formatter-only PR to leave Draft, with stated remaining diagnostics and scope. Root should still perform its final live Ready preflight/readback.
